identity.name: preOPAI - Powered by Republic for the Bitget Exchange

about.description: preOPAI is a tokenized Contingent Payout Note issued by Republic International Cayman and sold through Bitget IPO Prime on Solana, designed to mirror OpenAI stock performance upon a future IPO or acquisition. Holders own an unsecured debt claim against the issuer rather than OpenAI equity, with no voting or dividend rights. OpenAI is unaffiliated and actively disavows pre-IPO exposure products. Offered to non-US persons under Regulation S at $725/token (29,082 tokens, ~$21M). Trading occurs on the Bitget spot market with on-chain supply held in issuer/exchange omnibus custody.
